taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-b-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-20 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 64.6 | 2.65 | 2.65
2 | 775.4 | 0.67 | 3.32
3 | 110.3 | 1.09 | 4.41
4 | 222.5 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as KH-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-20
Curve type: KH-type
Aquifer depth: 3.32 - 4.41 m
Recommendation: Drill through the shallow weathered aquifer horizon between 3.32 m and 4.41 m, extending into the underlying bedrock to check for deeper water-bearing fracture zones. Install casing with screen positioned across the saturated interval and properly gravel-pack the zone to optimize yield.
